subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the 200-post clamp is fixed, should Mattermost cold-thread recovery keep the proposed one bounded fetch attempt per stored session, with no retry after a transient failure?
rationale: Source and tests can verify the implementation, but only the Mattermost owner can choose the intended tradeoff between repeated inbound latency and recovery from transient server failures.

options.title: Accept one bounded attempt
options.body: Keep the current marker semantics so each stored session pays at most one bounded recovery request and ordinary follow-ups never repeatedly block on Mattermost.

options.title: Retry after cooldown
options.body: Allow bounded transient retries after a cooldown, improving eventual context recovery at the cost of additional state and possible later-turn latency.

recommendation.title: Accept one bounded attempt
recommendation.body: Keep the current marker semantics so each stored session pays at most one bounded recovery request and ordinary follow-ups never repeatedly block on Mattermost.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person as the Mattermost area owner, making them the best available decision owner for channel latency and retry semantics.
